youtube.baslik: Why is listening so tiring with hearing loss? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: With hearing loss, the signal reaching the brain can be incomplete and distorted; the brain tries to fill in the gaps from context and lipreading. This extra work is called listening effort, and when it lasts all day it can lead to marked listening fatigue by evening.
